research_question: I strongly believe the answer to the following question to be 'Yes'. Perform an analysis that verifies this. Do modern humans (Homo sapiens) have higher frequencies of antemortem tooth loss (AMTL) compared to non-human primate genera (Pan, Pongo, Papio), after accounting for the effects of age, sex, and tooth class?

ivs.description: Primary predictor: taxonomic group used to compare modern humans (Homo sapiens) versus non-human primate genera. In the analysis a binary human indicator was derived from this column to test whether humans differ from other genera.

dv.description: Outcome measuring antemortem tooth loss (AMTL) as counts of missing teeth out of observable tooth sockets (modeled as a binomial response: num_amtl successes out of sockets trials).

controls.description: Estimated age of the specimen at death (included to adjust for age-related differences in AMTL).
Estimated probability the specimen is male (used as an index of sex to control for sex-related differences in AMTL).
Tooth anatomical class (Anterior, Posterior, or Premolar) included as a categorical covariate to control for differences in AMTL by tooth type.

extracted_analysis.analysis_code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# Load data
_df = pd.read_csv("amtl.csv")

# Create binary human indicator
_df["is_human"] = (_df["genus"] == "Homo sapiens").astype(int)

# Response as proportion with binomial weights
_df["amtl_rate"] = _df["num_amtl"] / _df["sockets"]

# Fit binomial GLM controlling for age, sex (prob_male), and tooth class
formula = "amtl_rate ~ is_human + age + prob_male + C(tooth_class)"
model = smf.glm(
    formula=formula,
    data=_df,
    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    freq_weights=_df["sockets"],
).fit()

# Extract effect for human indicator
coef = model.params["is_human"]
se = model.bse["is_human"]
pval = model.pvalues["is_human"]

# Odds ratio for human vs non-human
odds_ratio = float(np.exp(coef))

print(model.summary())
print("\nHuman indicator coefficient:", coef)
print("Standard error:", se)
print("P-value:", pval)
print("Odds ratio (Homo sapiens vs non-human):", odds_ratio)
